author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭಾವಜಾಗೃತಿಯಿರದೆ ಭಾವನೆಯರಳುವುದೆ
ಭಾವುಕತೆ ತುಂಬಿರಲು ಬದುಕೊಂದು ಚಿತ್ರ
ಭಾವಿಕನೆ ನೀನಾಗೆ ಜೀವನದ ಪಯಣದಲಿ
ಸಾವೆ ಅಂಜುವುದೆಂದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Without awakened feeling, can feelings bloom?
filled with sensitivity, life is a painting;
if you are one who feels, on life’s journey,
death itself will fear you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Feelings flourish only when we are awake to them. A sensitive heart makes life a work of art, and such a life has nothing to fear, not even death.
